verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਅਤਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਹਿਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal savaiaadh bisamaadh at akath kathaa binodh kahit na aaviee ||

en.bdb: The spiritual happiness of a devout Sikh of Guru who meditates on Lord's name, the bliss and his spiritual happiness is wonderful beyond explanation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਗੰਧ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਸੀਤਲ ਕੋਮਲ ਪਰਸਤ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmakh sukh fal ga(n)dh paramadhabhut seetal komal parasat ban aaviee ||

en.bdb: The peace and joy of a Guru-conscious person diffuses wonderful fragrance. Its tranquility and softness can only be realised when it is relished. There is no limit of the divine peace and wisdom of such a Guru-oriented person. It can understood best when a Sikh becomes one with his Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal mahimaa agaadh bodh gur sikh sa(n)dh mile alakh lakhaaviee ||

en.bdb: One who is a devout Sikh of Guru, the glory of his spiritual, knowledge gets reflected in every limb of his body umpteen times. Every hair of his body becomes alive with divine effulgence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਤੋ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal a(n)g a(n)g koT sobhaa maiaa kai dhikhaavai so to anat na dhaaviee ||15||

en.bdb: By his grace, whosoever is shown this state of spiritual bliss, does not wander about anywhere. (15)
